title: Annamalai LEAVES BJP | DOWNFALL Of BJP In Tamil Nadu?
description:
In this video, we discuss why Annamalai left the BJP and explore all the possible reasons and scenarios behind it. We look at Annamalai’s journey, from his early life and IPS career to his entry into politics. We discuss why he joined the BJP, how his ideology closely matched the party’s vision, and how he quickly rose to become the Tamil Nadu BJP president.

We also talk about the elections he fought, how he helped increase the BJP’s vote share in Tamil Nadu, and why he has always been a strong critic of Dravidian politics. The video examines whether the BJP sidelined him for political reasons and whether this move could actually be part of a larger strategy. We also discuss the possibility of Annamalai launching his own party, especially in a state where politics is often driven by strong personalities rather than party brands.

Dear Sham Sharma,
I respectfully differ with your examples of Assam, Odisha, and Bengal. In Tamil Nadu, the situation is quite different. There appears to be a strong lobby, both within and outside the party, that is aligned either with the DMK or the AIADMK. Many among them seem unwilling to work towards building the party independently.
A similar situation can be observed in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and especially Kerala. In Kerala, Rajeev ji is making sincere efforts, but we are all aware of the level of resistance and internal challenges he continues to face.
In my view, if the party wishes to fully utilize Annamalai's potential, it needs to decisively address the entrenched senior lobby that has repeatedly obstructed organizational growth. We have already seen instances where leaders who were effectively sidelined later returned and continued to influence matters in ways that undermined his efforts.
With the current style of leadership and organizational structure in Tamil Nadu BJP, the party may continue trying for years without achieving a meaningful breakthrough. That is an unfortunate reality that many grassroots supporters seem to recognize.
Just my personal assessment.
